p: to reason with God: For although he knew that God was just, which was revealed in his ordinary working and another in his secret counsel, yet he uttered his affection to God, because he was not able to understand the reason he punished him.
physicians of no value: You do not well apply your medicine to the disease.

wickedly for God: He condemns their zeal, who did not have knowledge, nor regarded they to comfort him, but always granted on God's justice, as though it was not evidently seen in Job, unless they had undertaken the probation of it.
remembrances are like unto ashes: Your fame will come to nothing.

take my flesh in my teeth: Is not this a revealed sign of my affliction and that I do not complain without cause, seeing that I am thus tormented as though I should tear my own flesh, and put my life in danger?
hypocrite shall not come before him: By which he declares that he is not a hypocrite as they charged him.
justified: That is, cleared and not cut off for my sins, as you think.
with me: To prove that God punishes me for my sins.
give up the ghost: If I do not defend my cause, every man will condemn me.
Withdraw thine hand far from me: He shows what these two things are.

mine iniquities and sins: His pangs move him to reason with God, not denying that he had sinned: but he desired to understand what his great sins were that he deserved such rigor, in which he sinned by demanding a reason from God why he punished him.
the iniquities of my youth: You punish me now for the sins that I committed in my youth.
stocks: You make me your prisoner, and so press me that I cannot stir hand or foot.
